Axiom: Hooks fire on every commit/push. `pre-commit` is verify-only: first require working tree == index, then run universal `verify --phase full` under its internal staged-candidate policy (types, coverage suite, production contract lint, format check, yagni) and the directive freshness/axiom/contract/halt/budget audits. It never omits formatter/autofix repair nodes and never re-stages bytes; read-only observations stay red until the author runs the project `fix`, stage the result, and retry. Budget is honestly tens of seconds because tests and types are whole-project. `commit-msg` (conventional-commits validator) stays required. Optional: `prepare-commit-msg` (prepend issue ID), `post-merge` (reinstall if lock changed). Hook config committed to repo; one onboarding command registers them (e.g. `lefthook install`).
